name: knowledge_document_invoke
label: Knowledge Version Creation Source
description: Records the source type and record ID that created a knowledge version. Historical entries without a version ID resolve to the active document version.

fields.name: knowledge_document_id
fields.description: ID of the associated knowledge document.

fields.name: invoke_id
fields.description: ID of the business record that created the version. Manual task conversion uses the process task ID. Alert handling uses the process task step instance ID.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Business source type that created the version.

fields.name: knowledge_document_version_id
fields.description: Version ID recorded at creation. Each version has at most one source. Historical associations may omit this value.

indexes.name: uk_created_version
indexes.description: Ensures that each associated version has only one creation source.

indexes.name: idx_source
indexes.description: Supports queries by business source type and source record identifier.

indexes.name: idx_document
indexes.description: Locates source associations for a document.
